Tatiyadukkhasutta Suffering (3rd)

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Yaṁ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṁ; tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo …pe… “Mendicants, you should give up desire and greed for what is suffering. …” yaṁ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṁ; tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti.

Sattamaṁ.
